_comment: The store-era counterpart of configs/panel.q19.json — the same 8 assays, the same chr19/chr21 split, read at LOAD time instead of baked in. `assays` IS the column order (D14): edit the list and the columns move, no re-bake. `store` points at CANDI_STORE/<corpus>, whose sibling `genome/` supplies dna.h5 and mask.h5. Smoke-sized on purpose: 5 biosamples, tiles at the context length, so it runs off the t9 five-biosample slice.
